column4: written in-project by an AI agent - inferred from the house voice and session records, not recorded (PROVENANCE.md); David to confirm

The WORDING is in-project since 10 Oct; the CONTENT is not. 334 readings derive from a pasted chat/notebook-tool answer summarising the degree-symbol authors Charubel, Sepharial, Kozminsky, Janduz, Muir, Henson, Weber and Matthews (165 rewritten earlier, 169 redrafted and spliced in on 10 Oct with David's approval; they had been that answer word for word). 26 - Sagittarius 11-20, Pisces 21-30, Aries 3, 4, 6, 15, 24, 25 - were written the same day from a second pasted answer David supplied; he names its source as Esther V. Leinbach, Degrees of the Zodiac (stated for Aries 3, assumed for the rest - David to confirm). Both pasted texts, the drafts and the measurements are in reference/degrees; how close either answer is to any book is NOT known

the symbol lines are the Jones/Wheeler symbols of 1925 (public domain); who wrote the summary keynotes is NOT known, and they read like Rudhyar 1973 - PROVENANCE.md item 2, the highest-risk question in the corpus
